sentences.quote: "Novartis announces CEO Joseph Jimenez to retire from Novartis in 2018. Vasant Narasimhan appointed CEO, effective February 1, 2018"
sentences.text: Vasant "Vas" Narasimhan, M.D., has been chief executive officer of Novartis AG since February 1, 2018, succeeding Joseph Jimenez at the Basel-based drugmaker.

He joined Novartis in 2005 from McKinsey & Company and held roles including Global Head of Drug Development and Chief Medical Officer, Global Head of Development, and country and vaccines leadership posts; he holds an M.D. from Harvard Medical School and a master's in public policy from Harvard's Kennedy School.

sentences.quote: He leads a company of more than 77 000 associates that does business in approximately 120 countries
sentences.text: As CEO he has refocused Novartis on innovative medicines and platforms such as siRNA, radioligand and cell and gene therapies, leading more than 77,000 employees across roughly 120 countries.

mgmt_bio.text: Vasant "Vas" Narasimhan, M.D., has been chief executive officer of Novartis AG since February 1, 2018, succeeding Joseph Jimenez at the Basel-based drugmaker. As CEO he has refocused Novartis on innovative medicines and platforms such as siRNA, radioligand and cell and gene therapies, leading more than 77,000 employees across roughly 120 countries. In April 2026 he was appointed to the board of directors of AI company Anthropic.

mgmt_recent.text: Mukul Mehta took over as chief financial officer and joined the Executive Committee on 16 March 2026, succeeding Harry Kirsch, CFO since 2013, who retired after a 22-year Novartis career and stepped down from the committee on 15 March 2026. In July 2026 Narasimhan said there was "no change of plans" for him and that he would lead the company through its next growth phase, while managing its heaviest patent expiries, including Entresto. He also stated that M&A strategy is unchanged for 2026, favouring sub-2-billion-dollar early-stage deals plus medicines launchable within five years.

thesis_pillars.text: Management frames 2026 as growing through the largest patent expiry in Novartis history, with full-year net sales expected to grow low single-digit and core operating income to decline low single-digit. Radioligand therapy is a scaling platform, with sites expanded to over 880 in the US and 650 outside the US ahead of further launches.
